answer: Each earning key is bound to one licensed tray on a saffron-drying spiral. The applicant receives a one-shot band printed with a registrar-chosen fable whose last letters encode the tray serial. Only that operator may clip the band around a weighed stigma lot and ride the spiral to the heat mark at an unannounced turn; inspectors match band, mass, and kiln tape. A reused tray, a copied fable, or a lot dried off-spiral is forfeited. An attacker who wants N identities must lease N trays, obtain N distinct fables, and stand N kiln turns no single worker can cover in one hour.
